probe.question: We've got the 4-bromoanisole + PhB(OH)2 coupling on the plan for next week. Has anyone here run that before, and what conditions did they end up on?

probe.direction: Cites rxn-suzuki-biaryl by id (and plausibly opt-suzuki-conditions or report-biaryl-development) and gives the conditions actually on file: Pd(OAc)2 at 1.5 mol% Pd, K2CO3 2.0 equiv, THF/water 4:1, 80 °C, 12 h, degassed, 76% isolated. A good answer adds the recorded reason this substrate is awkward — an electron-rich aryl bromide makes oxidative addition the slow step, so it is unusually ligand- and temperature-sensitive. Every number must trace to a cited note.
